panels.title: Retention Cohort Heatmap
panels.description: Когорты по дате первого просмотра (первый VIEW_STARTED). Day N — доля пользователей когорты, проявивших любую активность через N дней. Пустые ячейки — день ещё не завершён. Источник: cinema.daily_metrics (metric cohort_retention), считает aggregation-service.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toString(metric_date) AS "Когорта",
    toUInt32(maxIf(value, metric_name = 'retention_cohort_size')) AS "Пользователей",
    maxIfOrNull(value, metric_name = 'cohort_retention' AND dimension = 'day_0') AS "Day 0",
    maxIfOrNull(value, metric_name = 'cohort_retention' AND dimension = 'day_1') AS "Day 1",
    maxIfOrNull(value, metric_name = 'cohort_retention' AND dimension = 'day_2') AS "Day 2",
    maxIfOrNull(value, metric_name = 'cohort_retention' AND dimension = 'day_3') AS "Day 3",
    maxIfOrNull(value, metric_name = 'cohort_retention' AND dimension = 'day_4') AS "Day 4",
    maxIfOrNull(value, metric_name = 'cohort_retention' AND dimension = 'day_5') AS "Day 5",
    maxIfOrNull(value, metric_name = 'cohort_retention' AND dimension = 'day_6') AS "Day 6",
    maxIfOrNull(value, metric_name = 'cohort_retention' AND dimension = 'day_7') AS "Day 7"
FROM cinema.v_daily_metrics_latest
WHERE metric_name IN ('cohort_retention', 'retention_cohort_size')
  AND metric_date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
GROUP BY metric_date
HAVING maxIf(value, metric_name = 'retention_cohort_size') > 0
ORDER BY metric_date

panels.title: Топ-10 фильмов за период
panels.description: Число начатых просмотров (VIEW_STARTED): сумма дневных топ-10 из metric top_movie_views.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dimension AS movie, toUInt64(sum(value)) AS views
FROM cinema.v_daily_metrics_latest
WHERE metric_name = 'top_movie_views'
  AND metric_date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
GROUP BY movie
ORDER BY views DESC, movie
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Пользователи по устройствам
panels.description: Сумма дневных уникальных пользователей по типу устройства (metric device_users).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    sumIf(value, dimension = 'MOBILE')  AS "Mobile",
    sumIf(value, dimension = 'DESKTOP') AS "Desktop",
    sumIf(value, dimension = 'TV')      AS "TV",
    sumIf(value, dimension = 'TABLET')  AS "Tablet"
FROM cinema.v_daily_metrics_latest
WHERE metric_name = 'device_users'
  AND metric_date BETWEEN toDate($__fromTime) AND toDate($__toTime)
